description: Capability set for the capture-toast window (hq-idea-board US-005: capture toast with undo, note, reassign, open). Receives capture-toast:show via core:event. Invokes capture_toast_ready (ready handshake — delivers/shows any pending capture), dismiss_capture_toast (hide, never close), set_capture_toast_focusable (toggle focusable + focus so pressing N or clicking the note field can type — the window is built non-activating), ideas_delete_capture (undo), ideas_set_note (note), ideas_move_capture (reassign company), ideas_list_companies (reassign picker), ideas_open_board (open the desktop workspace on this idea), and get_authorized_file_preview (thumbnail).
